title: Burden of Sinners
overview: After Shizuka Hio’s death, peace is restored at the academy. But when Zero returns, the vampires of the Senate accuse him of murder.

title: The Eternal Promise
overview: Yuki has a lot on her mind after almost being kissed by Zero. She asserts that she will not speak to Kaname until he admits to Zero’s innocence.

title: The Azure Portrait
overview: The Night Class goes to the Aido family’s vacation home during the long break, but Hanabusa decides to stay at the academy to investigate Kaname.

title: Devil's Awakening
overview: While the Night Class is at the Aido family’s vacation home, Yuki, driven by her desire to stop hurting Zero, tries to regain her memory of the past.

title: The Subordinate's Trap
overview: Yuki is continually haunted by visions of blood. Nevertheless, she is determined to find out about her past from Kaname.

title: The Fake Lovers
overview: Kaname asks Yuki to be his lover. The Night Class guards begin accompanying her everywhere, and Yuki cannot hide her embarrassment.

title: The Kiss of Thorns
overview: Senri returns to the Academy, but upon having a confidential talk with Ichiru, he becomes noticeably different from before.

title: Spiraling Recollections
overview: Yuki wakes up a vampire, and her memory of her childhood returns. She now remembers her father, her mother and her brother.

title: Revival of the Mad Emperor
overview: Yuki now understands who she really is. Worried about Zero, she sneaks out of her room to find him -- but he simply can't accept what she has become.

title: Prelude to the Battle
overview: The Headmaster calls for an emergency evacuation of the Day Class students, as Rido’s servant vampires begin attacking the students.

title: Two Souls
overview: In order to protect the academy, the Headmaster confronts the head of the Hunter Society while Rido is still on the rampage.

title: World's End
overview: Yuki decides that as Guardian, she must protect all the students at the academy and fight Rido.

title: Vampire Knight
overview: All of Zero’s strength is not enough to kill Rido -- he will need Kaname's help. But the fight will leave Cross Academy devastated.
